metadata.eulerUnit: native angle (degree interpretation inferred from values; not declared by metadata)

quaternion.convention: Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll), degrees; not calibrated or source-native

metadata.poseFrame: native HTC VIVE tracking frame; axes/origin undocumented
metadata.skeletonFrame: native glove coordinates; node00 and node25 are zero roots, separate from VIVE world; not fused
metadata.skeletonTopology: not declared; do not assert finger connectivity or left/right mapping
metadata.gazeUnit: native x/y (undocumented; pixel-like values); not normalized or projected to ego camera
metadata.gazeCamera: observation.images.eye_rgb; correspondence inferred from Pupil Labs device, no gaze-camera calibration supplied
metadata.alignment: episode-relative parquet timestamps, nearest neighbor poses/skeleton/gaze, no clock offset added

eeg.method: arithmetic mean in non-overlapping 10ms episode-time bins; visualization only, not clinical analysis

leftEmg.method: arithmetic mean in non-overlapping 10ms episode-time bins; visualization only, not clinical analysis

rightEmg.method: arithmetic mean in non-overlapping 10ms episode-time bins; visualization only, not clinical analysis
